title: Ridgecrest RxSecure Cost Sharing for a One-Month Retail Fill
content:
The figures below are what a member of a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan pays for a 30-day fill, by the formulary tier the product sits on and by the standing of the dispensing pharmacy. A copay is a figure in USD; a coinsurance is a percentage of the negotiated price.

## Preferred retail pharmacy

| Plan | Tier 1 preferred generic (USD) | Tier 2 generic (USD) | Tier 3 preferred brand (USD) | Tier 4 non-preferred drug (per cent) | Tier 5 specialty (per cent) | Tier 6 select care (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 0.0 | 8.0 | 47.0 | 50 | 33 | 0.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 0.0 | 6.0 | 44.0 | 48 | 33 | 0.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 1.0 | 5.0 | 42.0 | 45 | 31 | 0.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 2.0 | 4.0 | 40.0 | 42 | 29 | 0.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 0.0 | 3.0 | 37.0 | 40 | 27 | 0.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 0.0 | 2.0 | 33.0 | 35 | 25 | 0.0 |

## Standard, non-preferred retail pharmacy

| Plan | Tier 1 preferred generic (USD) | Tier 3 preferred brand (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 12.0 | 54.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 10.0 | 51.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 9.0 | 49.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 8.0 | 47.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 6.0 | 44.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 5.0 | 40.0 |

## Reading the grid

The same tier is written at a different figure on every plan, and the same plan is written at a different figure for a standard retail pharmacy than for a preferred one. On Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) a 30-day tier 3 preferred brand fill is 42.0 USD at a preferred retail pharmacy and 49.0 USD at a standard retail pharmacy; the same fill on Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) is 37.0 USD and 44.0 USD. Tier 6 select care is written at 0.0 USD on all six plans. On tiers 4 and 5 the member's share is a percentage of the negotiated price rather than a fixed figure: 50 per cent and 33 per cent on Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP), falling to 35 per cent and 25 per cent on Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP).
